sql: select e.key as experiment, d.deployment_key, d.kind, d.started_at, d.ended_at, a.strategy_tag from experiment_deployment_arms a join experiment_deployments d on d.id = a.deployment_id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id = d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id = ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id = v.experiment_id where a.strategy_tag like '%mmsell%' order by d.ended_at nulls first, a.strategy_tag
